response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"Paragraph 1, line 5","severity":"major","source_quote":"Rejoice and praise the King of Kings!","suggested_fix":"Replace with “Furahini na msifu Mfalme wa Wafalme!”","translation_quote":"Furahi; mshangilie na mnumbeni Mfalme wa Wafalme!"},{"location":"Paragraph 1, line 6","severity":"major","source_quote":"Give thanks and laud, for more is here!","suggested_fix":"Replace with “Toeni shukrani na sifa, kwa maana mengi zaidi yamekuja!”","translation_quote":"Mpe shukrani na sifu, maana mema zaidi yamekuja hapa!"},{"location":"Paragraph 2, line 2","severity":"major","source_quote":"Extol and praise His worthy name!","suggested_fix":"Replace with “Litukuzeni na kulisifu jina lake linalostahili!”","translation_quote":"Mtukuzeni na mnumbeni jina lake linalostahili!"},{"location":"Paragraph 2, line 4","severity":"minor","source_quote":"And showers blessings from above,","suggested_fix":"Replace with “Naye humimina baraka kutoka juu,”","translation_quote":"Na hunyesha baraka kama mvua kutoka mbinguni,"},{"location":"Paragraph 2, line 6","severity":"major","source_quote":"Adore and praise our mighty Lord!","suggested_fix":"Replace with “Mwabuduni na kumsifu Bwana wetu mkuu!”","translation_quote":"Mtukuzeni na mbariki Bwana wetu Mwenye Nguvu!"},{"location":"Paragraph 3, lines 1–2","severity":"major","source_quote":"Give thanks and sing to Christ our King / And worship Him with reverent praise;","suggested_fix":"Replace these lines with “Toeni shukrani na kumwimbia Kristo, Mfalme wetu, / Nanyi mwabuduni kwa sifa za heshima;”","translation_quote":"Mshukuru na imbe kwa Kristo mfalme wetu / Na mnamwabudu kwa sifa za kuheshimu;"},{"location":"Paragraph 3, line 6","severity":"major","source_quote":"Adore th’ almighty King of Kings!","suggested_fix":"Replace with “Mwabuduni Mfalme wa Wafalme Mwenyezi!”","translation_quote":"Mtukuzeni Mfalme wa Wafalme Mwenye Nguvu!"}],"passed":false,"score":72}
